description: Department of Forest Conservation - Siratikulam and Amadhipuram as Reserved Forests - Siratikulam reserved Forest and Amadhipuram reserved Forests are subjected to the single control of the Conservator General of Forests
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of state land as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It includes detailed geographic coordinates and boundaries for the land parcel, which is characteristic of land-related gazette notifications. While it mentions a State Minister, the core content focuses on land designation and property matters rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
